source: Delta india_testnet 5m public candles cached for delta-october-comparison.json
rules: Every 10 minutes from midnight IST, provided t+10m is strictly before the window end. Rank five symbols by previous closed candle price divided by close 12 five-minute bars earlier. Skip if all returns equal. Ties sort by symbol. For ETH/BTC variants use latest closed log price ratio vs population mean and SD of 24 preceding closed log ratios, trigger absolute z>2. Pair rows are long and short equal-dollar positions. Require all five ranking inputs, and available prior ETH/BTC ratio history for ratio variants. Model fills using open prices of entry and exit five-minute bars with positive traded volume on both ends for each leg. Retrospective price availability mask. No costs, funding, size limits or historical quote/queue model. Pooled nominal percentage returns per gross notional, positive above 1e-12 counts as win, flat counts as non-win.
